<!-- agent-roundtable:generated template=issue-retro version=0.1.0 -->

One comment per agent return: agent · task or PR · model · bounced at review (y/n) · the `## Feedback` section verbatim ("None" included).

The architect also logs: lane slips (with a post-mortem: what happened, why the persona or brief allowed it, the prompt change proposed), wrong briefs, re-dispatches, findings right-first-time should have prevented, bugs found after merge, the owner's corrections.

At the retro: what worked, what didn't, root causes, proposed changes (each with its owning agent and the decision needed). Approved changes get an issue. The next retro checks they landed.
